description: This file defines an interface (abstract class) IAudioContentProtection for Bluetooth A2DP audio content protection, including methods for configuration, protection, unprotection, and serialization.

classes.name: IAudioContentProtection
classes.description: An interface for audio content protection in Bluetooth A2DP, providing methods for configuring, protecting, unprotecting, and serializing content.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the protection with a specified format.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the protection capabilities or state into a buffer.
